title: enter_demo's reset omits payment/scoring state that handle_browser_change resets, contradicting its own 'mirroring' comment
evidence:
+          // Reset navigation UI state, mirroring handle_browser_change —
+          // entering the demo from the landing page must not carry an open
+          // dropdown/confirm/modal into the sandbox.
...
+      payment_polling: None,
+      payment_poll_count: 0,
+      payment_error_count: 0,
+      scoring_generation:,
detail: enter_demo resets dropdowns/modals but not payment_polling, poll/error counts, scoring_generation bump, scoring_status, or landing_intro_video_playing — all reset by handle_browser_change. Mid-session demo entry inherits live real-session polling and scoring chains into the sandbox.
recommended_fix: Make enter_demo apply the full handle_browser_change reset set (payment polling, scoring generation/status, landing intro video), or extract one shared navigation-reset helper both call.

title: Deep-linked demo entry sets request ids but not the Loading flags the equivalent real route-entry path sets
evidence:
+          // A deep-linked demo edit page needs its id set so the
+          // get_for_edit response is accepted and the form can load.
+          vacancy_edit_id: edit_id,
...
+        vacancy_detail: Loading,
+        vacancy_detail_request_id: Some(id),
+        leaderboard: Loading,
...
+          vacancy_detail_request_id: request_ids.0,
+          application_detail_request_id: request_ids.1,
detail: enter_demo sets only request ids; vacancy_detail/leaderboard stay NotAsked and vacancy_edit_loading stays False, unlike handle_browser_change's fresh-entry arms. Deep-linked demo detail/edit pages initially render the NotAsked/not-loading branch.
recommended_fix: In enter_demo, set vacancy_detail/leaderboard to Loading for deep-linked detail/handoff routes and vacancy_edit_loading: True for the edit route, matching handle_browser_change.

title: Demo boot skips session check and listeners; a live real session is silently discarded and never re-discovered
evidence:
+    True -> {
+      let #(demo_model, demo_eff) = enter_demo(base_model, route)
+      #(demo_model, effect.batch([modem.init(BrowserChangedUrl), demo_eff]))
+    }
...
+      // restore + background listeners — there is no session, and the demo is
+      // static.
...
+        auth_api.check_session(ApiReturnedSession),
detail: A cookie-authenticated landlord deep-linking /demo boots with demo_saved_auth = NotAsked; the comment's 'there is no session' is false for them. After demo exit no check_session ever re-fires, forcing re-login despite a valid session.
recommended_fix: On demo exit to a public route (or demo boot in background), re-dispatch auth_api.check_session so a still-valid session is restored rather than the stashed NotAsked.

title: Demo seed-failure fallback sets model route to Landing without URL change or user feedback
evidence:
+    Error(_) -> #(
+      Model(..model, route: routes.Landing, demo_mode: False, demo_store: None),
+      effect.none(),
+    )
detail: Model claims Landing while the browser URL still shows /demo (or the deep link); no modem.replace, no toast. A refresh re-enters the failing seed path, looping silently.
recommended_fix: Emit modem.replace("/") alongside the fallback and surface a toast; never let model.route diverge from the address bar.

title: routes.Dashboard arms in enter_demo/demo_entry_effects are unreachable
detail: enter_demo is only called for routes.Demo or is_demo_route routes; Dashboard falls to `_ -> False` in is_demo_route, so the Dashboard arms in demo_entry_effects and the vacancies Loading case can never execute.
recommended_fix: Drop the Dashboard arms (in-demo /dashboard is already served by handle_browser_change's NotAsked gate) or document them as defensive.

title: is_public_route hand-duplicates the inverse of is_protected_route and the two lists already diverge
evidence:
+fn is_public_route(route: Route) -> Bool {
+  case route {
+    routes.Landing
+    | routes.Login
+    | routes.Signup
+    | routes.ForgotPassword
+    | routes.ResetPassword -> True
+    _ -> False
+  }
+}
...
-    routes.Landing
+    routes.Demo
+    | routes.Landing
detail: Demo-exit clearing keys off a second hand-maintained public-route list that already disagrees with is_protected_route (Demo is non-protected yet not 'public'). Future public routes drift between gating and demo-state clearing.
recommended_fix: Derive is_public_route as the negation of is_protected_route (minus Demo) or route both through one shared classifier.

title: Demo CSRF plumbing inconsistent: model carries literal 'demo-csrf-token' while demo_api mutations pass empty string
location: client/src/client.gleam:enter_demo and demo update_vacancy arms (hunks @@ -2414,20 +1847,43 and @@ -5346,93 +4950,1007)
evidence:

...

detail: Two sources of truth for the demo CSRF token. Any unchanged mutation arm still reading model.csrf_token would send the fake literal to the real API in demo mode.
